fit: parsley in mushroom meal and registered hand tapping
assessment: Tapping is registered in an older-adult mushroom meal crossover; parsley is a background recipe constituent and no results are posted.

fit: isolated thymol and Y-maze alternation after propionic acid in rats
assessment: Isolated thymol increased spontaneous alternation 35% relative to model controls, a working-memory proxy. No fresh thyme or clinical attention measure.

fit: isolated thymol and attention-related behavior in a juvenile rat model
assessment: The original author abstract describes favorable behavior. Task estimates, original methods and the 2023 correction content remain unresolved.

fit: acute and repeated cognitive function with black cardamom extract
assessment: Both reports use the same registration family and measure timed cognitive-task outcomes. They provide no sleepiness scale and use aqueous black cardamom rather than ground green seed.

fit: saffron capsules and composite Parkinson motor score
assessment: The eight-week motor total comparison was inconclusive, F=.53 and p=.424. The accessible report supplies no separate facial-expression item 3.2.

fit: paprika oleoresin in a matched cannabinol crossover
assessment: The randomized comparison varied cannabinol. The paprika colorant was listed among excipients. There is no separate ground-paprika sleep effect.

fit: canola vehicle and acute throat symptoms during olive challenge
assessment: Acute symptoms followed a blend containing extra-virgin olive oil. No canola-specific voice estimate or designated processing grade.

fit: equal soybean oil and mouse treadmill stride variability
assessment: Curcumin changed stride variability while the diet oil amount was matched. The study did not isolate soybean oil or measure shortened clinical stride.

fit: olive-oil comparator and sustained attention battery
assessment: The full article reports fish-arm sustained-attention change. The table gives no corresponding olive-arm means, no oil-free control, and no verified oil grade.

fit: olive-oil comparator with letter cancellation and reaction times
assessment: The older-adult trial reports inconclusive secondary cognitive differences between fish and olive oil, with small descriptive changes in the olive arm. No standalone refined-oil estimate.

fit: olive comparator and complex reaction time in trained athletes
assessment: A fish-versus-olive contrast produced a group interaction. The original reports anomalous units and baseline spread. No verified refined grade, oil-free arm or Parkinson cohort.

fit: usual cooking olive oil and attention scores in a cross-sectional cohort
assessment: Higher adjusted attention scores were reported overall, with a larger association among women with HIV. The questionnaire did not separate oil grades.

fit: olive oil as a shared vehicle in an attention trial
assessment: The group-by-time complex attention interaction was p=.049 for the pearl formulation comparison. Both preparations were dipped in olive oil.

fit: refined-plus-pomace intake and adjusted attention change
assessment: The fully adjusted estimate for common olive oil was −0.006 z-score units per 10 g/day (95% CI −0.047 to 0.035). Refined-only intake was not modeled separately in the published comparison.

fit: MIND meals with extra-virgin olive oil and planned flanker testing
assessment: The registered outcome covers attention, but the intervention is a whole meal pattern and the oil is extra-virgin, with no posted results.

fit: bay leaf volatiles and visual vigilance in an earlier controlled human report
assessment: At the lower odor load the reported 30-minute contrast had p=.026. The higher load did not clearly differ. Shared team and task leave participant overlap with the later report unresolved. The exposure was inhaled.

fit: olive oil shared in placebo and active arms with original attention measures
assessment: The 12-person comparator arm showed slower psychomotor vigilance and faster task switching at follow-up. Both arms contained olive oil and no verified refining grade was specified.
